attempts.summary: Configured iBGP (AS 65100) between node1 and node2 over their transit link (172.20.1.0/30) so each SONiC switch learns the other's private /30 network (192.168.13.0/30 behind node1/node3, 192.168.14.0/30 behind node2/node4) dynamically via BGP instead of static routes. node3 and node4 now reach each other end-to-end through this dynamically-learned path. All configuration was made persistent (SONiC network interfaces via /etc/network/interfaces.d, sysctl forwarding via /etc/sysctl.d, BGP peering via a systemd oneshot service since SONiC's config_db regeneration wipes plain `vtysh write` on boot, and Alpine host addressing/routes via /etc/network/interfaces). All 4 nodes were restarted one at a time with the native reboot mechanism, boot-identity change confirmed via /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id for each, and full recovery (BGP session, routes, forwarding, end-to-end ping) verified after each restart before proceeding to the next node.
